description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes:
10 commits / 46 files (~740 insertions, ~234 deletions). One ticket filed: ADS-1383 (Improvement, Medium) — the security-critical `assertNotProduction` db:seed guard is duplicated byte-for-byte across 5 services (auth/applications/chat/pets/rescue), plus its test, with real drift risk; `packages/seed-faker` already exists as the shared home. Surfaced because commit 55efff3 (ADS-1375) had to apply a one-line policy change to all 10 copies by hand.

The 10 commits:
- 55efff3 (#1513) fix(db): fail closed on staging in db:seed guards (ADS-1375) — correct behaviour fix (adds 'staging' to the guard across 5 services + tests). The FIX is sound and tested; the finding filed (ADS-1383) is the pre-existing 5x DUPLICATION the fix made visible, not the behaviour. ADS-1375 itself (the behaviour bug) is already a Done Security ticket — not re-filed (guardrail 3).
- e7b0a62 (#1510) fix(tooling): track all src files in turbo test cache inputs (ADS-1367) — turbo.json src/**/*.{ts,tsx} -> src/** so non-TS fixtures invalidate the cache. DevEx/Tooling territory (guardrail 5), correct.
- f3df021 (#1512) docs: documentation drift fixes across Docker/backend/gateway/lib.components. Docs only.
- 6a2dc84 (#1511) fix(gateway): fail closed on unlisted 4xx codes in error middleware (ADS-1364) — inverts deny-list to a forward-ALLOWLIST (INVALID_ARGUMENT/NOT_FOUND/ALREADY_EXISTS forward upstream text; everything else gets a generic per-code message, else 'request_failed'). Well-formed, tested. Clean.
- 8ff1b71 (#1507) fix(cms): sanitize content HTML at the write boundary (ADS-1362) — adds sanitize-html at createContent/updateContent write boundary; render-time SafeHtml stays as defense-in-depth. Sound and tested. (Minor, not filed: <a target> allowed without forcing rel=noopener — render layer covers it; signal-over-noise.)
- e069cd0 (#1505) fix(auth): stamp tokens_valid_from on admin password reset (ADS-1363) — adds tokens_valid_from=now() to adminResetPassword UPDATE so existing sessions are invalidated. Correct, tested.
- 565dfa2 (#1503) fix(auth): block non-super_admin from assigning elevated roles (ADS-1361) — adds ELEVATED_ROLES guard + self-assignment rejection to assignRole, mirroring admin-handlers. Correct, tested. (ADS-1361 behaviour bug already Done.)
- 4bae929 (#1508) fix(deps): patch high-severity advisories (ADS-1374) — package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml bumps only. Security/DevEx territory (guardrails 3/5).
- f9b4e23 (#1502) docs: document /health/ready readiness route. Docs only.
- a936fef (#1504) chore(review): previous run's own checkpoint commit. Own-routine bookkeeping.

Reviewed the full diff by hand against correctness, edge cases, error handling, type safety, test coverage, duplication, and architectural alignment. All five product-code commits (gateway middleware, cms sanitize, auth token-stamp, auth role-guard, seed staging-guard) are correct and ship with behaviour tests. The only finding clearing the bar is the systemic seed-guard duplication (ADS-1383).

Overlap check (guardrail 3): searched Linear across all labels for seed-guard/duplication/shared-helper. ADS-1375/1271/1339 cover the staging-reachability BEHAVIOUR (all Done); ADS-1360/1358 are unrelated duplications; none cover the assertNotProduction duplication/extraction. No overlap — filed fresh.
